name: TOO Cloud Compatibility
description: Keeps cloud/SaaS blockers visible as errors and demotes stylistic noise so real findings are not buried. Rule IDs below were verified by compiling this project with alc.exe + the shipped analyzers.

rules.justification: Every table needs a matching permission set or the extension cannot be installed/used on a cloud tenant.
Area-type name used as a control name. Documented to become a hard error in a future release; fix before it blocks a cloud upgrade.
Duplicate method signature on a table. Documented to become a hard error in a future release.
Implicit enum/integer conversions. All current hits are this project's own enums, not deprecated platform APIs, so this is a code-health signal rather than a cloud blocker.
Placeholder count does not match the arguments. Throws at runtime when that path executes; a cloud tenant gives no debugger to catch it.
Possible string overflow. In SaaS an overflow is a hard runtime error with no on-prem debugging available.
Unreachable code - usually a logic slip worth reviewing.
StrSubstNo inside Error breaks telemetry/translation of error messages in SaaS.
Missing ToolTip. Not cloud-relevant; 145 hits would bury real findings.
Label/comment conventions. Not cloud-relevant.
Possible string overflow. Real bug class, but not a cloud blocker; keep as warning.
Label naming conventions. Not cloud-relevant.
Label placeholder comments. Not cloud-relevant.
Unused variables. Expected noise from #if ONPREM gating in this project.
Redundant begin/end. Stylistic.
Variable declaration ordering. Stylistic.
Label placeholder usage. Stylistic.
ToolTip punctuation. Stylistic.
Object/field naming length conventions. Not cloud-relevant.
Variable assigned but never used. Expected from ONPREM gating.
